elementValueMap.estatusDesactivacion: =IF(%orderType% = 'Cancelacion',  IF((%responseRoot:AssetRoot:Status% = 'Suspended' || %responseRoot:AssetRoot:Status% = 'Active'),"success","El Asset debe tener estatus activo o suspendido para una Cancelación"  ),"false")
elementValueMap.estatusReactivacion: =IF(%orderType% = 'Reconexion',IF(%responseRoot:AssetRoot:Status% = 'Suspended',"success","El Asset debe tener estatus suspendido para una Reactivación"),"false")
elementValueMap.estatusReinstalacion: =IF(%orderType% = 'Reinstalacion',IF(ISBLANK(%responseRoot%)&&%DME_getDeactivatedSubscription:AssetRoot:Status% = 'Deactivated',"success","El Asset debe tener estatus cancelado para una Reinstalacion"),"false")
elementValueMap.estatusSuspension: =IF(%orderType% = 'Suspension',IF((%responseRoot:AssetRoot:Status% = 'Suspended' ||%responseRoot:AssetRoot:Status% = 'Active'),"success","El Asset debe tener estatus activo o suspendido para una suspensión"),"false")
